business_scope.primary_industry_name: Construction of Thermal Multi-Stage Flash and Membrane Desalination

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 May 1984, in force)
France-China Income Tax Treaty (signed 26 Nov 2013, effective 1 Jan 2015)
France-US Income Tax Convention (1967, as amended through the 2009 Protocol)
EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (signed 30 Dec 2020, ratification pending)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 to R.561-60 of the French Code monétaire et financier (CMF), as amended by Ordonnance n° 2020-115 of 12 February 2020 (transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843); UBO register governed by CMF Articles L.561-46 to L.561-49 and R.561-5 to R.561-28, operated through the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) and the INPI Guichet Unique; EU wire-transfer transparency under Regulation (EU) 2015/847 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2019/2175.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each foreign member's passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary or competent consular authority in the member's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (procuration) authorising the French incorporation signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / certificate of incorporation of any corporate member
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign commercial registry or competent corporate register

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of association (statuts) of any corporate member
Bank reference letter validating source of funds and credit standing
Proof of registered address of foreign members (utility bill or lease, max 3 months old)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign public utility provider or municipal authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the French PEP definition (CMF Article L.561-10), the EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU Council Regulation (EC) 2580/2001, and the OFAC SDN list (best practice for USD-denominated SWIFT wires and project escrow). Enhanced due diligence applies to PEPs for 12 months after termination of public functions. Suspicious transaction reporting to TRACFIN under CMF Article L.561-15; sectoral guidance of the ACPR and the Commission Nationale des Sanctions applies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI; RCS and UBO data searched via data.inpi.fr and infogreffe.fr.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Articles R.123-53 and R.123-54 of the French Commercial Code require all filings and annexed instruments to be in French; foreign-language documents must be accompanied by a sworn translation prepared by a traducteur agréé. The corporate name must be expressed in Latin-script characters; non-French names in the Latin alphabet are admissible, while non-Latin scripts must be Latin-transliterated. The exact dénomination sociale must appear on all commercial documents (Article L.123-9 of the Commercial Code).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not issue a standalone name-reservation certificate; the name is cleared and recorded at the moment of incorporation. Upon refusal by the registrar (greffier), the applicant may: (i) re-submit a corrected filing via the Guichet Unique; (ii) file written observations with the greffe; (iii) appeal the refusal to the President of the Commercial Court within 30 days of notification under Article L.123-5-1 of the Commercial Code, including through interim relief (référé); and (iv) claim damages from the registrar where the refusal is found wrongful. Full-range INPI and EUIPO trademark collision searches are recommended before filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible under Articles L.123-11-2 and R.123-166 of the French Commercial Code: the registered office may be domiciled with an authorised commercial domiciliation company for a maximum successive period of five years under a written agreement filed with the RCS. For a desalination EPC contractor (ISIC 4322) reliant on public-works tenders, project-financing escrow accounts and SWIFT banking facilities, a pure virtual office is generally rejected in practice by French banks and tendering authorities, which expect a verifiable operational head office in France. Recommended structure: a physical lease or serviceable office arrangement with the registered office recorded as an annex thereto.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15% per annum for a standard SARL; unannounced physical inspections of the registered office are not a standard feature of the French RCS regime, but the risk rises to approximately 40% where a full virtual office is used and the company bids on public-procurement desalination works, engages site labour (inspection du travail), or triggers anti-fraud review by the DNLF or TRACFIN.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name distinctiveness and trademark clearance (INPI national register, EUIPO, Infogreffe/RCS search)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory search fees plus prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SARL articles of association and corporate-governance annexes
Notarization and Hague apostille of foreign shareholder/member identity, good-standing, POA, address-proof and bank-reference bundle (6 document sets)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary or consular authority in country of origin plus French competent authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille fees at approximately USD 100 per document set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translations (traduction assermentée) of corporate instruments and apostilled documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur agréé près la cour d'appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing translator tariff of approximately EUR 70-80 per page, estimated at 6 pages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet Unique / RCS incorporation filing fee including UBO declaration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fixed tariffs (INPI platform EUR 50; registrar fee approximately EUR 77)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in a legal-announcement journal (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per inserted line, approximately EUR 200-260

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office set-up and commercial substance (first-year domiciliation agreement or physical lease setup and legal due diligence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of EUR 2,500-3,500 for a commercial-location arrangement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank KYC/AML pre-incorporation file preparation for project-financing escrow and SWIFT wire rails
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French banking institution plus external AML compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for EPC-class KYC file assembly and sanctions screening

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-34 on Société à Responsabilité Limitée; supplemented by Code de l'environnement and Décret n° 2023-1394 on the single business formalities window.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce (Commercial Court Registry), processed through the INPI Guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and recorded in the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création de société (M0 integrated in the mandatory single online filing), transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce via the INPI single window.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: French SARL has no statutory minimum capital; the articles may fix a nominal capital of EUR 1 or higher, but all cash contributions must be fully subscribed and irrevocably deposited into a blocked escrow account held by a French bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations before registration; funds may be released only upon issuance of the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscribers, representing 100% of the share capital, adopt the attached articles of association of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée. RESOLVED FURTHER: That all cash contributions are irrevocably deposited in a blocked account, verified, and corresponding shares are allocated. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the registered office is fixed at [address], France, as stated in Article 4 of the articles. RESOLVED FURTHER: That [Name] is appointed Manager (gérant) with full powers to represent the company, open bank accounts, execute the incorporation filing, pursue industrial licensing, and pay all fees. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the Manager may delegate necessary formalities. This resolution is effective immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name clearance and drafting of articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI trademark search and Greffe du Tribunal de commerce; drafting by an Avocat or Notaire.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a conflict search on the INPI trademark database and the commercial registry records. Draft the French-language statuts containing corporate form, duration, registered office, corporate object (construction of thermal and membrane seawater desalination plants), share capital, share transfer rules, manager powers, and dissolution provisions. If any contribution is in-kind property requiring authentication, the articles must be notarized.
required_dossiers: Individual identity documents of all shareholders and proposed manager
Declaration of non-conviction (attestation de non-condamnation) of the manager
Proof of address of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable or challenged, select a new distinctive name, amend the draft bylaws accordingly, and reserve the amended version before proceeding to capital deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of a blocked escrow account and deposit of share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution, Notaire, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After signature of the articles by all shareholders, open a temporary blocked account in the company’s intended name. Transfer all cash contributions to this account. The bank or notary issues a certificate of deposit (attestation de dépôt des fonds). This certificate must be annexed to the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and registered office details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the deposit, correct the signatory documentation and provide updated source-of-funds evidence; obtain a new attestation before filing the incorporation application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory legal announcement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legally approved journal d'annonces légales in the département of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal notice to the approved legal announcement newspaper containing the proposed corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, and manager details. The announcement must be published before the incorporation filing and the publisher must provide a certificate of publication.
required_dossiers: Copy of the articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the newspaper refuses publication due to incomplete statutory data, correct the announcement and resubmit. Obtain a new certificate of publication and include it in the next filing step.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application via the INPI single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and Greffe du Tribunal de commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the integrated M0 creation declaration online through the Guichet unique, attaching the signed articles, attestation de dépôt des fonds, certificate of legal announcement publication, identity and address proofs, and manager declarations. Pay the official registration fees electronically. The Guichet unique automatically distributes the file to the Commercial Court Registry, INSEE, tax authorities, and social security agencies.
required_dossiers: Completed and digitally signed M0 declaration
Identity documents of shareholders and manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query or rejection, cure the missing exhibits within 15 days through the same Guichet unique portal; provide corrected documents and pay any additional fee before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Kbis extract, SIREN registration, and RNE entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce and INSEE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Commercial Court Registry verifies the application, assigns the SIREN number, and enters the company in the Registre National des Entreprises. The official immatriculation extract (extrait Kbis) is issued, evidencing the legal existence of the SARL. The company is then fully incorporated and may open a definitive bank account and sign contracts.
required_dossiers: Application file number issued by the Guichet unique
Copy of the M0 declaration receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any Kbis data is inaccurate, file a rectification request with the Greffe accompanied by supporting evidence; the registry must correct the register within a reasonable delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation fiscal, social, and administrative activations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques, DREAL, and DREETS.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm automatic social security registration with URSSAF, complete any tax option filings, open the definitive professional bank account, and initiate applications for environmental and industrial authorizations. Establish the corporate books and statutory registers. Where required, apply for the environmental operating permit before commencing any construction activity on site.
required_dossiers: Project description and technical schematics for desalination works
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF or the tax authority reports inconsistencies, file the relevant rectification declarations through the official online portals; coordinate with DREAL for any industrial permit deficiency and correct technical dossiers before resubmission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) under the Ministry for Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion, together with the Préfecture du département and DDTM for maritime domain matters.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation Environnementale Unique / ICPE Operating Authorization for Seawater Desalination Plant, including abstraction and brine discharge permits under the French Environmental Code.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autorité Environnementale (AE) via CGEDD and DREAL; Ministry for Ecological Transition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A — Full EIA Report required: environmental impact assessment, public inquiry, and water authorization under Articles L.181-1, L.214-3 and R.122-2 of the Code de l'environnement for desalination capacity above applicable thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Brine discharge must not raise the receiving seawater salinity by more than 1 g/L above the baseline at the edge of the mixing zone; discharge temperature delta shall not exceed 5°C; residual chlorine shall be below 0.02 mg/L in the final effluent; antiscalant and coagulant chemicals must comply with European REACH and environmental quality standards; all solid waste and false rejects must be classified and disposed per European Waste Catalogue and ADEME requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the departmental fire and rescue service (SDIS) based on emergency evacuation and fire-fighting systems; structural load inspection report validated by a licensed engineer; electrical installation conformity certificate (CONSUEL); occupational health and workplace safety clearance from DREETS/DIRECCTE; and, where applicable, construction site authorization from the municipal mayor.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) of the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; e-portal: impots.gouv.fr (professional Espace Professionnel). The local SIE (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) handles VAT registration, filing, and refunds.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned SARL is created through the National Single Window (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) at the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce, obtaining an INSEE SIREN, SIRET establishment number and KBIS. The DGFiP then attributes the French intra-Community VAT number under the FR + key + SIREN formula. A non-resident company without a French entity upstream of a desalination EPC contract must apply to the competent SIE for an Article 289 A CGI VAT identification, submitting the ownership certificate, board/PoA, appointment of an accredited tax representative if no EU establishment, and evidence of any fixed establishment or local contracting activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no check-the-box regime. A single-member EURL may, if not exclusively carrying commercial activity with corporate shareholders, exercise an option under Article 239 bis AA CGI to be taxed as a partnership (pass-through) at the shareholder level. Multi-member SARL is compulsorily subject to French corporate income tax (IS). A group meeting the 95% shareholding and pre-agreement conditions may elect OT fiscal integration under Articles 223 A ff. CGI. Hybrid mismatch and entity misclassification adjustments are mandatory ATAD/CGI Articles 212 ter/quater rules, not optional elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée - TVA), including the French intra-Community reverse-charge and immovable-property reverse-charge rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For domestic established taxpayers, the franchise en base de TVA limits are EUR 91,000 annual turnover for goods (tolerance EUR 101,000) and EUR 36,600 for services (tolerance EUR 40,900); exceeding the tolerance triggers mandatory VAT registration and collection. A construction/EPC SARL carrying out seawater desalination works must register from the first euro when it invoices taxable recipients, because the place of supply of immovable-property works is France; the small-business threshold is therefore of limited application to this ISIC 4322 EPC scope.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing and e-reporting in France phases in under the Facturation électronique reform: all taxpayers must be able to receive structured e-invoices from 1 September 2026; large enterprises must issue them from 1 September 2026, and SMEs/VSEs from 1 September 2027. Invoices must be transmitted through an approved Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) or the Public Portal (PPF) in EN 16931-compliant formats (Factur-X, UBL, CII). No real-time digital stamp or DGFiP pre-clearance exists; however, transaction data and invoice metadata are transmitted via e-reporting to DGFiP, enabling pre-filled VAT returns and audit analytics. API interoperability and electronic-seal authentication mandates follow the PPF technical specification; non-compliant issuance is a tax-law violation and exposes the issuer to sanctions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported physically from France to a destination outside the European Union are exempt from VAT with a right to deduct input VAT under Article 262-I CGI; the exporter must prove the movement out of the EU by retained customs and transport evidence. Services connected with immovable property located outside France (e.g. desalination works performed on a plant site abroad) are outside the scope of French VAT under Article 259-A CGI, and services supplied B2B to a customer established in a third country are generally taxable in the customer's jurisdiction, allowing French input VAT recovery where the purchases are directly connected to the zero-rated or out-of-scope export output.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en douane d'exportation - DAU/B65) with the export ledger acceptance stamp
Bill of Lading (or CMR/Air Waybill) evidencing physical departure from the EU customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit confirmation evidencing settlement of the export invoice in the exporter's French account
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP will re-classify any unsupported or sham export invoice to a domestic taxable supply, subject to the statutory limitation period, with VAT reassessed at 20%, disgorgement of input VAT recovered, plus 0.20% per month statutory interest. Bad faith provides a 40% penalty increase, while organised tax fraud (manœuvres frauduleuses) triggers the 80% penalty and criminal prosecution under Article 1741 CGI, including personal imprisonment and fines for directors, together with the joint recovery of VAT and penalties from the corporate assets and any unjustified refunds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a liberalized capital account regime under EU law with full convertibility for the Euro. Non-resident capital movements are unrestricted; resident outflows require prior declaration to the Banque de France for transactions exceeding €100,000 thresholds. Profit remittance from French SARL subsidiaries to foreign parents is permitted without restriction provided transfer pricing compliance and beneficial ownership disclosure are satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds applies under French law. Foreign exchange receipts must be declared to the Banque de France within 30 days of receipt; conversion to Euro occurs at prevailing market rates unless contractually stipulated otherwise. Project-related export invoices require supporting documentation for tax and AML verification.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited viability for offshore digital electronic money institutions due to strict ACPR oversight and French AML/CTF requirements; corporate clients engaged in large-scale EPC project financing must utilize traditional banking rails for escrow and clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners must appear physically for initial KYC interviews and document verification; remote electronic onboarding is not permitted for French SARL entities under current regulatory standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening adverse hit or adverse media exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full source-of-funds and source-of-wealth report, independent legal opinion on ownership chain, and enhanced due diligence file

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership or control structure discrepancies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Extract from Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), beneficial ownership declaration, and corporate chart with shareholding percentages
Comprehensive risk assessment, third-party verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring protocols

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 to French IBAN accounts using purpose code 'Project Capital Injection' or 'Equity Contribution'; all wires require matching KYC documentation, invoice support, and bank verification prior to crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements utilize SWIFT MT103 for direct payments or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit through correspondent banks; all disbursements supported by project invoices, delivery notes, and EPC contract references.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps for multi-year project funding

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale, form 2065 with schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 2nd business day after 1 May for fiscal year ending 31 December; generally by the 3rd month after fiscal year-end for off-calendar fiscal years
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due plus default interest at 0.20% per month; after formal notice additional 40% or 80% penalties may apply

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (bilan, compte de résultat, annexe) with auditor’s report where applicable, filed with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 months of the end of the fiscal year, preceded by shareholder approval of the accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end unless extended by court order
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within 7 months of fiscal year-end triggers penalties up to €1,500 (€3,000 for legal entities); administrative strike-off risk after repeated non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO annual declaration (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days of filing annual accounts, or immediately upon any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to €15,000 and imprisonment up to 6 months for deliberate omission; administrative penalties for non-declaration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT return (CA12) where the entity is subject to monthly VAT filings or under the real regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly by the 19th of the following month; annual recapitulative return due by 31 December (filing via form 3517) for eligible simplified regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late VAT filing penalty of 5% (plus 0.80% per month) of the tax due; possible assessment and seizure in case of persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Social security declarations and payment of employer charges (DSN social declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: URSSAF (Union de Recouvrement des Cotisations de Sécurité Sociale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly filing by the 5th or 15th of the month following payroll; annual summary for employer contributions due by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 5% of contribution amount due plus late payment interest; potential criminal sanctions for wilful non-declaration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory when the entity exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds: balance sheet total > €4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax > €8,000,000; average number of employees during a fiscal year > 50. For small SARL meeting at least two thresholds below, audit exemption applies unless requested by a shareholder or required by judicial authority.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Règlement ANC 2014-03, CRC 99-02) as codified in the French Commercial Code; IFRS mandatory for consolidated financial statements of listed entities only, not applicable for ordinary SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each SARL must confirm and update its beneficial owner register (RBE) at each filing of annual accounts or within 15 days of any change in the direct or indirect ownership of more than 25% of capital or voting rights. The declaration includes full identity, residential address, nationality, date and place of birth, and the nature and extent of control. The register is kept at the registered office and made available to the judicial authorities and the company’s officers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registre des Décisions et Registre des Gérants)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: €150 – €1,200 per year for commercial registered office or legal agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: €3,500 – €12,000 per year for statutory audit, depending on plant size and complexity; small SARL exempt from audit may incur lower compliance costs

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax rate (Article 219 CGI) for fiscal years opened from 2022; reduced 15% rate on first €42,000 of taxable profit for eligible small and medium enterprises.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% IS rate for SME profits up to €42,000; Research Tax Credit (CIR) covering 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to €100M; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) of 20% of innovation expenditure for SMEs; indefinite carryforward of tax losses subject to annual cap of €1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable income exceeding €1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (déclaration de résultats) with annexes 2050 through 2059 and related certificates, filed electronically through the EDI-TDFC / EFI portal on impots.gouv.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; Corporate income tax is payable in four quarterly instalments for companies with a year exceeding 03 months, plus a final payment upon filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months of the close of the fiscal year; for a fiscal year ending 31 December, the final due date is 30 April, extended to 15 May for electronic filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting result (bénéfice ou déficit de l'exercice) before tax integration adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident SARL must report only the profit or loss of its French permanent establishment, prepared under French accounting standards.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal result after add-backs and deductions (e.g., reintegration of non-deductible provisions, exceptional depreciation).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the CGI add-back rules to the PE's French-source income; allocate turnover between France and foreign activities under the DTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Losses carried forward to the current year, to be deducted from the taxable result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses of the French PE may be carried forward; the deduction is subject to the annual cap and ownership continuity test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Re-integrations of expenses or revenues previously deducted; includes excess depreciation, payments to tax havens without substance, and certain benefits in kind.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE must re-integrate non-deductible charges paid to its head office or related non-resident enterprise, unless substantiated and at arm's length.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an automatic 10% penalty on the declared tax due; if the return is not filed within 30 days of a formal demand, the penalty increases to 40%; late payment carries monthly interest of 0.20% and additional penalties of up to 80% for concealed activity (Article 1729 CGI).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% withholding tax on gross dividends paid to non-resident companies (Article 119-2 CGI), subject to reduction under tax treaties or Parent-Subsidiary Directive (0% for qualifying EU/EEA parent entities); a 3% additional distribution levy (Article 235 ter ZCA CGI) also applies unless treaty-exempt.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident beneficial owner must obtain a residence certificate (TRC) from its tax authority and submit a treaty claim (Form 5000/5001 or online through impots.gouv.fr) before the distribution, enabling the French paying company to apply the reduced rate at source; if not submitted in time, a claim for refund may be filed within 3 years (Article 118 CGI).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: domestic withholding rate of 25% exists for certain debt-claims, but payments are generally exempt between EU/EEA associated enterprises under Directive 2003/49/EC and reduced to 0% under most French DTAs. Royalties: domestic withholding rate of 33.33% (Article 182 A bis CGI) on French-source IP royalties; treaty rates typically 0% for EU/EEA associated companies or 10–15% for non-EU residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €400 million group consolidated turnover (or €50 million standalone threshold for response obligations) requires preparing and filing the Master File/Local File and TP documentation with the annual return (Article L13AA LPF).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies the OECD arm's-length principle and an abuse-of-law doctrine (Article L64 LPF) requiring substance over form; a French entity claiming treaty or Directive benefits must maintain genuine economic substance (staff, premises, real decision-making); shell companies are denied benefits under BEPS Action 6 and the EU anti-tax-avoidance directives.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate concealment of turnover from desalination EPC contracts, false invoicing through shell subcontractors, cash payments to project facilitators, or omission of income attributable to the French PE.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine up to €500,000 (Article 1741 CGI); tax reassessment plus penalty of 40% for deliberate misconduct or 80% for organised fraud (Article 1729 CGI).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who ordinate the concealment may be jointly liable for the company's tax debt; a judicial management ban, asset seizure, travel ban, and imprisonment may be imposed (Article L653-3 Commercial Code).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Imposing inflated intra-group charges (e.g., design fees, procurement commissions, financing interest) on the French SARL to erode French taxable profit without arm's-length comparables or economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-assessment of taxable profits under Article 57 CGI; adjustment of interest deductibility under Article 212 CGI; additional tax of up to 80% in bad-faith cases and 0.20% monthly interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: SI will be recharacterised as hidden distributions; directors may incur joint liability if they authorised payments with knowledge of sham transactions; criminal exposure under Article 1741 if intended to evade IS.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / lack of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox SARL in France with no real management, staff or premises while routing desalination project revenues through foreign accounts, and claiming French treaty benefits without substantive presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of French residency and treaty/Directive relief; application of the abuse-of-law procedure (Article L64 LPF) with penalty 80% of the tax avoided; reassessment of profits as French-source.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced for misuse of corporate assets (abus de biens sociaux) under Article L242-30, leading to personal liability for unpaid taxes and up to 5 years' imprisonment for directors.
